regulatory_frameworks.notes: LOT-16 qualifies the generic projection engine, versioned statement definitions, validated company-account mappings, controls, comparatives, drill-down and immutable snapshots. It does not yet claim statutory PCG statement templates or French regulatory-export compliance; those remain profile/reference work for LOT-17 and later qualification.
LOT-16 is framework-neutral and can project validated mappings from SYSCOHADA-based company charts, but no official SYSCOHADA statement profile or regulatory export is claimed at this milestone.
